sql:
WITH customer_orders AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerKey,
        ProductKey,
        SalesAmount,
        count(DISTINCT SalesOrderNumber) OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerKey) AS order_count
    FROM retail.FactOnlineSales
)
SELECT
    pc.ProductCategoryName,
    sum(co.SalesAmount) AS total_sales,
    sumIf(co.SalesAmount, co.order_count >= 2) AS repeat_customer_sales,
    round(sumIf(co.SalesAmount, co.order_count >= 2) / sum(co.SalesAmount) * 100, 2) AS repeat_customer_pct
FROM customer_orders AS co
INNER JOIN retail.DimProduct AS p ON co.ProductKey = p.ProductKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductSubcategory AS ps ON p.ProductSubcategoryKey = ps.ProductSubcategoryKey
INNER JOIN retail.DimProductCategory AS pc ON ps.ProductCategoryKey = pc.ProductCategoryKey
GROUP BY pc.ProductCategoryName
ORDER BY repeat_customer_pct DESC;
